author: Unreal Engine
description:
Discover how Unreal Engine 5 animation tools and techniques helped Gameloft Brisbane bring the iconic 2D world of Bluey to life in 3D.

In Bluey’s Happy Snaps, Bluey and Bingo explore locations from the popular kids’ animation, taking photos with Dad’s old camera in a mission to fill out scrapbooks. 
Watch this video to explore how Gameloft Brisbane went all-in on Unreal Engine to capture the show’s distinctive visual style for the game, and the role UE5’s animation toolset played in bringing these much-loved characters to life.
